description: Search available motorcycle transport routes in France. Filter by departure city, arrival city, and date range. Returns paginated results with dates, prices, available slots, a next_cursor for the following page, and for each trip a booking_url that opens its booking page on symone.fr (the stops searched are pre-selected). Primary route: Paris–Marseille from 299€. No authentication required.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the previous call; repeat the same filters with it.

page.description: Page number (default: 1). Ignored when cursor is given.

name: search_routes
title: Search scheduled motorcycle transport trips
